scenarios.name: Local Administration Portal
scenarios.problem_scenario: Does the localized product expose an administration portal inside the customer network?
risk_identification: A weakly protected local administration portal may permit privilege escalation.
Shared administrator accounts may prevent accountability in customer environments.
security_control_requirements: Require MFA and role-based authorization for every local administrator.
Restrict the administration portal to an explicit customer network allowlist.
Record immutable audit events for privileged configuration changes.

scenarios.name: Offline Update Package Import
scenarios.problem_scenario: Can administrators import an offline installation or upgrade package into an isolated deployment?
risk_identification: A tampered offline package may execute attacker-controlled code during installation.
Untrusted removable media may introduce malware into an isolated environment.
security_control_requirements: Verify the vendor digital signature before importing an offline package.
Reject expired, downgraded, or replayed update packages.
Scan removable media and record the package checksum in the audit trail.

scenarios.name: Enterprise Directory Authentication
scenarios.problem_scenario: Does the product authenticate customer users through an enterprise directory?
risk_identification: Insecure directory integration may expose credentials or allow unauthorized group mapping.
Stale directory memberships may retain access after a user changes roles.
security_control_requirements: Use encrypted directory transport and validate the directory server certificate.
Map directory groups to least-privilege application roles.
Synchronize account disablement and audit every directory authentication decision.
